    ONE FORMAT. MANY WAYS IN.
    A journal that can change with you.
    01 / WORDS
    Write your way.
    Free writing, rapid logs, Markdown, dated entries and your own headings. No required daily file.
    02 / PAPER
    Paper when you want it.
    Print your pages handwritten on a dot grid (Look → Handwritten), and attach pictures of paper pages to keep them with the words.
    03 / STRUCTURE
    Make room for more.
    Optional measurements, prompts and diagram source live alongside prose. Inspect what the JavaScript parser sees.

    The writing comes first.
    

    What’s playing?
    

    Keep a song and a little of the setting with this entry. Enter any service’s link yourself, or fetch playback from Spotify, Last.fm or ListenBrainz. Review before adding.
    

    

    Last.fm / ListenBrainz

    Read your public listening activity. Your player or scrobbler must already send tracks to the service. Nothing is submitted by Jot.

    Scrobbler setup and privacy
    

    Enter a song yourself, or connect Spotify to fetch currently playing information.
    

    

    Spotify connection settings
    Use a Spotify developer app’s public Client ID. No client secret is needed. Access is limited by Spotify’s current app and allowed-user requirements.
    Setup instructions · Spotify developer dashboard
    

    Only requested playback details are fetched. Your writing is not uploaded. The Spotify connection ends when this page reloads; saved notes remain plain text.

    Each choice is separate and changes only how this page looks for you. They are remembered in this browser, never written into your journal.

    Lock this journal
    

    Your journal is encrypted with a passphrase, in this browser, with its built-in cryptography. From then on this browser keeps only the encrypted copy, and Download locked saves a .jotlock that unlocks with Jot or a few lines of Python or Node.
    

    • Nobody can reset it. Jot never keeps or sends your passphrase. If you forget it and have no recovery code or passkey, nobody can open this journal, you included. A password manager is a good place for it.
    • Copies you downloaded before are not locked. A locked file's name, size and dates still show.
    • It does not help if someone uses this browser while the journal is unlocked.
    





    Passkeys and security keys (a phone, a YubiKey) can be added afterwards, under Ways in.
    

    

    Unlock
    

    Type the passphrase this journal was locked with.
    





    

    Your recovery code
    

    It opens this journal like the passphrase does. It is shown only now, and Jot keeps no copy. Save it in a password manager or write it down, and keep it apart from the journal.
    

    

    

    Ways in
    

    Each of these opens this journal. A passphrase or a recovery code always stays, so it can be opened anywhere, with or without this site. Changes ask for one current way in first. Copies you downloaded before keep the ways in they had.
    

      

      Add a passkey or security key
      A passkey on this phone or computer, or a security key such as a YubiKey, unlocks with a touch, a fingerprint, your face or a PIN. It works only on this site (), and only with browsers and keys that support it. A synced passkey is as safe as the account it syncs with; and someone can make you unlock with your face or finger more easily than make you tell a passphrase.
      


      

      Recovery code
      A new code replaces the old one.

      Quick note for today
      

      It goes at the end of today’s dated entry, which is made if there is none. Otherwise your cursor stays where it was. Undo (Ctrl+Z) takes it back.

      Import health data
      

      Daily numbers from Apple Health’s export.xml (unzip export.zip first) or a CSV from Health Connect, Google Fit, Fitbit, Garmin or Oura. The file is read on this device; nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. You choose the numbers and dates and see every record before anything changes.
      

      Never read: medications, lab results and clinical records, reproductive and sexual health, and location. Jot writes the numbers as measured, in the units the app used, and never draws conclusions from them. How each number is counted
